external_rss.reason: All three recorded stage samples were zero. In a fresh live control, a child with a touched 64 MiB allocation and native ru_maxrss of 73,088 KiB produced only 466,944 bytes from the /proc process-tree sampler. Both zero and nonzero /proc samples are untrusted in this execution environment; they can refer to unrelated processes. The exact PID/proc visibility mechanism was not established by this audit.

resource_measurement_status.proc_scope: All /proc-derived zero and nonzero process-tree RSS samples are unusable here because process IDs may refer to unrelated processes.

native_search_counter.scope: Linux search-worker process high-water counter through the end of tiled search. It is not the entire pipeline process tree or the later joint-refinement stage.
limitations: No worker-start baseline was recorded, so inheritance of a prior high-water counter was not separately excluded.
This self counter is not an independent whole-pipeline memory measurement.

resource_measurement_status.policy: Invalidate /proc-derived samples only. The direct native self-process counter remains reportable with its stated scope and limitations.
